policy: qa_acceptance_ready may be true only when every required Issue #13 QA item is satisfied and each satisfied item has repository evidence.

items.title: RTMP/RTMPS/SRT major flows are automated
items.notes: Automated coverage exists, but this checklist does not infer full release acceptance from transport-specific CI alone.

items.title: Major disconnect and recovery scenarios are reproducible
items.notes: Deterministic recovery and network-degradation coverage exists; remaining Issue #13 fault and evidence slices must be closed before satisfaction.

items.title: OBS compatibility evidence is recorded
items.notes: Requires sanitized manual evidence in the compatibility matrix; automated FFmpeg evidence is not a substitute.

items.title: At least two mobile publisher applications are verified
items.notes: Requires reproducible device/app/network evidence. Do not infer mobile support from desktop software.

items.title: Hardware encoder compatibility is recorded
items.notes: If hardware is unavailable, keep this pending or blocked rather than claiming compatibility.

items.title: A six-hour-or-longer soak test passes
items.notes: Normal PR validation remains bounded; satisfied requires a canonical passing soak report with both target and observed duration of at least 21600 seconds from a dedicated long-running acceptance run.

items.title: Node capacity is derived from load-test evidence
items.notes: max_sessions must be based on measured load with an explicit safety margin, not a guessed target; satisfied requires a repository coverage manifest that binds the canonical load plan to one canonical measured report for every required scenario.

items.title: Pre-beta release acceptance checklist exists
items.notes: This fail-closed checklist is machine-validated and remains not ready until every other required item is satisfied.
